definitions.full: H5552. salsillah [ סַלְסִלָּה ] noun [feminine] basket according to ᵑ9 ᵐ5 AV RV; but probably shoot, branch Ew Hi Gf Gie and others; only plural absolute כְּבוֺצֵר (read probably יָד ) עַלסַֿלְסִלּוֺת יָָֽדְךָ הָשֵׁד Jer 6:9 . סלע (√ of following; compare Arabic cleave, split , cleft, fissure , Lane 1406, hence סֶלַע split, jagged cliff, crag , often isolated (split off) rock (compare Wetzst De Isaiah 3, 696-707; and especially ZAW iii((1883), 273 ); then of smaller fragments, Late Hebrew סֶלַע rock, stone , also scale (of serpent), weight (in trade); Aramaic סִלְעָא specifically weight for coin; Nabataean סלי , a coin Lzb 329 Cook 85 ).

occurrences.englishText: Yahweh of Armies says, “They will thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”
